codeReview.summary: The feature removes several production debug logs and successfully drops the sidepanel perf-monitor code from the shipped dist bundle via a build-time-only __PERF_DEBUG__ gate. However, it no longer exposes window.sidePanelUI in normal sidepanel sessions, which breaks existing E2E/debug automation that assumes that handle remains available outside perf-debug builds.

issues.description: `window.sidePanelUI` is now assigned only inside the `if (__PERF_DEBUG__)` block. Existing scripts/tests still access `window.sidePanelUI` unconditionally (for example `tests/e2e/run-e2e.ts:82`, `:153`, `:210`, and `scripts/capture-screenshots.ts:66`), so production/non-perf builds lose that UI handle and those flows regress. The debug cleanup should remove perf logging without changing the availability of the established sidepanel UI hook.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The repo relies on a global `window.sidePanelUI` hook for E2E and screenshot automation outside perf-debug mode, but that convention is not documented in mission/shared-state guidance.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `tests/e2e/run-e2e.ts` and `scripts/capture-screenshots.ts` access `window.sidePanelUI` directly, while `.factory/library/architecture.md` and mission `AGENTS.md` do not mention this requirement.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The refactor-worker skill does not explicitly warn that bundle-cleanup changes must preserve existing test/debug hooks that are consumed by automation, even when those hooks look debug-related.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: The transcript shows the worker identified `window.sidePanelUI` only after deciding to move the assignment behind `__PERF_DEBUG__`, and the skill text focuses on validators/file size rather than preserving automation hooks.

summary: Fail: the bundle optimization itself is valid, but the change regresses existing sidepanel automation/debug flows by hiding `window.sidePanelUI` in non-perf builds. No other blocking issues found in the reviewed diff.
